notes: New: configurable Telegram send times. Telegram Channel > Settings now has a 'Send time windows' section with one row per daily post - set 'From' and 'To' to the same time for an exact fixed send time, or a real range (e.g. 10:00-11:00) to have a random time picked within it independently each day. The number of rows always follows 'Blog posts per day' above it. Also, each post's own 'Edit' screen (Telegram Channel > Queue) now lets you change that specific post's scheduled send time directly, alongside its message text. No database update needed for this update.
